title: Peppercorn Co. crest
caption: The fat lime sausage read as a pickle.

title: Easel House crest
caption: Random daubs on a lilac board read as a screen.

title: Ironvein crest
caption: A brown rock with a three-pixel blue vein: at dock size a grey sack, no Ironvein blue.

title: Rosethread crest
caption: The dotted winding read as a jar of buttons.

title: Moonquill crest
caption: The quill was a solid white blade, so the mark read as a scimitar and shield.

title: The five crests as a family
caption: Can you tell the five apart at 16 and 32 px, and do they look like one set?

title: Company standards: the logo is sewn on
caption: Each logo was drawn in its cloth's own colour, so only its outline showed; a patch of deeper dye now sews it on.

title: The lock
caption: The small lock's shackle was outline only, so on dark wood it was a box; it now has its own steel.

title: The gold coin (shell)
caption: The 7 × 7 coin was a gold square beside the run's round coin; now it is round, lit, its far edge in shade.

people: The Sovereign Route · the trade war
title: Sovereign crest and the leader's crown
caption: Two paper jewels over a dark band made the crown a smiling face; it now has a raised centre point and one ruby on its band.

title: The second-term gold rim
caption: The rim was a 1 px hairline round 2 px pixels, in the themed accent (lime under Peppercorn); now one crest pixel wide, in --gold.

title: Flag emblems (5 × 5)
caption: Eight company emblems read as something else at 3×: the gem and palette as skulls, the rose as a key, the chili and quill as slashes.

title: Map towns, woods and peaks
caption: Towns were flat boxes, the pines black blots, the peaks tents; now houses with roofs, lit pines and peaks with a shoulder. Roads stay first.

title: Codex tile frames
caption: The frames used pure white and black; they now use the cream text and warm shade tokens, so a tile sits on the wood.

title: The home at phone width (390)
caption: The whole home before and after: crests, coin, gold rim, towns, woods and peaks. Nothing moves between picks (home-stability passes).

title: PROPOSAL · Butcherblock crest and standard
caption: Proposal, not shipped: a haunch on the bone in brine-red #c25b6b, for Easel House's slot. Judge the read at 1× and 2×.

title: PROPOSAL · Greenvial crest and standard
caption: Proposal, not shipped: a potion flask with a sprouting cork and glowing spores, in bottle jade #2fa58a, for Moonquill's slot.

title: PROPOSAL · The five as they would be
caption: Proposal: Peppercorn, Butcherblock, Ironvein, Rosethread and Greenvial side by side. Do they still read as five?

title: FIX? · Rare is the CTA's teal
caption: Not changed: Rare #5fb0c4 sits ΔE 4 from the CTA teal #57a2b6, so a Rare rail reads as a button. Retuning a token needs your call.
